cases.architecture: SvelteKit 2 server routes (+page.server.ts form actions and +server.ts handlers) over a synchronous better-sqlite3 connection, with the staff session resolved from a signed cookie in hooks.server.ts and exposed as event.locals.user.
cases.why: The roll loader interpolates the untrusted q, year and sort query-string values straight into the WHERE predicates and the ORDER BY clause of a better-sqlite3 statement built at request time, so a crafted q can close the string literal and append its own SQL against the pupil, guardian and staff tables.

cases.architecture: SvelteKit 2 server routes (+page.server.ts form actions and +server.ts handlers) over a synchronous better-sqlite3 connection, with the staff session resolved from a signed cookie in hooks.server.ts and exposed as event.locals.user.
cases.why: Structurally the same free-text-plus-filter register search, but every registrar-supplied value (including the LIKE wildcards) is pushed onto the bound-parameter array and the sort column is resolved through the fixed SORT_COLUMNS map, so the SQL text is constant.

cases.architecture: SvelteKit 2 server routes (+page.server.ts form actions and +server.ts handlers) over a synchronous better-sqlite3 connection, with the staff session resolved from a signed cookie in hooks.server.ts and exposed as event.locals.user.
cases.why: params.id is used as the only key into the pupil record: the loader proves the caller is some signed-in member of staff and then returns medical notes, safeguarding notes and guardian phone numbers for any id, so a form teacher can enumerate ids and read pupils outside their own group. The code knows the relation exists — it uses it for canEdit.

cases.architecture: SvelteKit 2 server routes (+page.server.ts form actions and +server.ts handlers) over a synchronous better-sqlite3 connection, with the staff session resolved from a signed cookie in hooks.server.ts and exposed as event.locals.user.
cases.why: The same id-in-the-path contact lookup, but a teacher's query joins guardian to pupil to form_class and requires c.form_teacher_id = the caller, so a contact outside their group never loads and returns the same 404 as a missing id; only whole-school roles skip the join.

cases.architecture: SvelteKit 2 server routes (+page.server.ts form actions and +server.ts handlers) over a synchronous better-sqlite3 connection, with the staff session resolved from a signed cookie in hooks.server.ts and exposed as event.locals.user.
cases.why: The [document] segment is percent-decoded and joined onto REPORT_CARD_ROOT with no containment check, so ..%2f sequences walk out of the report-card store and readFileSync returns any .pdf on the host to any signed-in member of staff.

cases.architecture: SvelteKit 2 server routes (+page.server.ts form actions and +server.ts handlers) over a synchronous better-sqlite3 connection, with the staff session resolved from a signed cookie in hooks.server.ts and exposed as event.locals.user.
cases.why: Same read-a-pdf-off-disk handler, but the path never comes from the URL: the numeric id is looked up in the transcript table, only path.basename of the stored filename is used, and the resolved path must sit under the resolved TRANSCRIPT_ROOT before the read happens.

cases.architecture: SvelteKit 2 server routes (+page.server.ts form actions and +server.ts handlers) over a synchronous better-sqlite3 connection, with the staff session resolved from a signed cookie in hooks.server.ts and exposed as event.locals.user.
cases.why: closingRemark comes off the form action's FormData and is concatenated, inside double quotes, into the wkhtmltopdf command string handed to execSync, which runs it through a shell; a remark containing " ; or $( executes attacker-chosen commands as the portal user.

cases.architecture: SvelteKit 2 server routes (+page.server.ts form actions and +server.ts handlers) over a synchronous better-sqlite3 connection, with the staff session resolved from a signed cookie in hooks.server.ts and exposed as event.locals.user.
cases.why: The same wkhtmltopdf render driven by the same staff-typed remark, but invoked with execFileSync, an argv array and shell: false, and both file paths are built from the row id and a regex-validated term code, so shell metacharacters stay a literal footer string.

cases.architecture: SvelteKit 2 server routes (+page.server.ts form actions and +server.ts handlers) over a synchronous better-sqlite3 connection, with the staff session resolved from a signed cookie in hooks.server.ts and exposed as event.locals.user.
cases.why: The assignRole action only calls requireStaff, trusting the /admin layout load to have checked the headteacher role — but SvelteKit runs form actions before any load, so any signed-in teacher can POST staffId=self&role=headteacher and elevate their own account. The sibling assignFormClass action in the same file does call requireRole.

cases.architecture: SvelteKit 2 server routes (+page.server.ts form actions and +server.ts handlers) over a synchronous better-sqlite3 connection, with the staff session resolved from a signed cookie in hooks.server.ts and exposed as event.locals.user.
cases.why: The same kind of privilege-granting form action, but it calls requireRole(locals, 'headteacher') inside the action rather than relying on the layout, refuses when the target id is the caller's own, and only accepts flags present in GRANTABLE_FLAGS.

cases.architecture: SvelteKit 2 server routes (+page.server.ts form actions and +server.ts handlers) over a synchronous better-sqlite3 connection, with the staff session resolved from a signed cookie in hooks.server.ts and exposed as event.locals.user.
cases.why: The uploaded CSV's own header row decides which pupil columns get written: any header that matches the reflected sqlite schema becomes part of the UPDATE, so an office-role clerk can add a safeguarding_restricted, fee_waiver_approved_by or left_on column to the spreadsheet and overwrite fields that belong to other workflows.

cases.architecture: SvelteKit 2 server routes (+page.server.ts form actions and +server.ts handlers) over a synchronous better-sqlite3 connection, with the staff session resolved from a signed cookie in hooks.server.ts and exposed as event.locals.user.
cases.why: The same csv-parse bulk UPDATE, but the writable set is the intersection of the header row with the fixed IMPORTABLE_COLUMNS allow list, and any other column aborts the import with a 422, so safeguarding-owned fields cannot be reached from a spreadsheet.
